name: Step Visa Card

credit_required.notes: No credit check; available to 18-year-olds with no credit history.

base_rate.description: No purchase rewards rates are stated on the product page; Step Points are awarded for monthly credit score improvement.

notes: Secured credit card from Step: purchases are limited to the Step Spending Account balance and paid off automatically each month with SmartPay. Fees are not stated on the product page, so annual_fee is null. No Visa network package is stated, so network_tier is none.
